[SWS_Can_00202]
⌈When
Can_DisableControllerInterrupts
has
been
called several times, Can_EnableControllerInterrupts must be called as many
times before the interrupts are re-enabled.⌋
Implementation note:
The function Can_DisableControllerInterrupts can increase a counter on ev-
ery execution that indicates how many Can_EnableControllerInterrupts need
to be called before the interrupts will be enabled (incremental disable).
